temperate:
Original fantasy strategy game MOUNTAIN RANGE SPRITE ATLAS, transparent RGBA, 5 by 5 cells, exactly 25 isolated sprites. This revision MUST BREAK THE SQUARE / PYRAMID look: NO regular triangular mountains, NO pyramids, NO conical mound, NO rectangular platform, NO centered symmetrical island, NO same outline in every row. Use strongly asymmetric irregular cutout silhouettes. Each subject is a HUGE multi-tile natural mountain formation, joined craggy slopes with jagged spurs trailing in different directions, tapering fragmented foothills. Elevated three-quarter map perspective, rich handpainted late 1990s pre-rendered strategy-game detail, fixed light upper-left. Five composition categories by column: 1 long crooked diagonal S-shaped ridge with three unequal offset peaks and low trailing spur; 2 crescent-shaped broken mountain wall, open concave side, tall peak at far left and sprawling low right shoulder; 3 narrow jagged zigzag mountain spine, two tall off-center peaks, very unequal length branches; 4 sprawling forked Y-shaped massif with uneven front fingers and a tall rear crag; 5 broad low winding escarpment with steep fractured cliff at one end and a single tall offset peak behind, long tapering tail. Make every row's rendition different in its silhouette, proportions and orientation without changing camera or light. Wide subjects should be wide and low, tall subjects narrow and high; do not force them into square compact piles. Jagged irregular alpha contour including concave notches, some slopes nearly touch edge of adjacent imaginary footprints when used in game; absolutely no flat tile-shaped ground pad. BUT all 25 sprites MUST remain separated in this atlas: each subject wholly inside its own equal cell, at least 20px entirely transparent gutter between subjects, no touching rows/columns. No text, no labels, no scenery behind. Not a terrain tilemap, these are alpha cutout mountains.
Terrain palette by row, exactly: ROW1 grassy plains gray limestone with only olive foothill grass; ROW2 forest dark gray mountains with tiny dense trees along lower slopes; ROW3 mire dark mossy slate mountains with muted olive wet foothills; ROW4 highland gray-brown bare granite with lichen; ROW5 coastal gray-beige pale limestone with sparse scrub.
